payload.title: MPT Core Length Comparison
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook analyzes the Mid-Pleistocene Transition (MPT) by comparing core lengths from various ocean drilling programs. It utilizes datasets from PANGAEA and processes them using the pyleoclim library to analyze oxygen isotope data. The notebook reads data files, processes time and isotope values, and visualizes the results using matplotlib and seaborn. The analysis focuses on identifying discontinuities and comparing core data across different sites.
goals: Compare core lengths from different ocean drilling programs during the MPT.
Analyze oxygen isotope data to understand climate transitions.
Visualize core data to identify patterns and discontinuities.

section_blurbs.blurb: This section introduces the notebook's purpose of comparing core lengths during the MPT using datasets from PANGAEA. It imports necessary libraries and suppresses warnings for presentation purposes.
section_blurbs.heading: MPT Core Length Comparison

section_blurbs.blurb: This section defines group lists for loading core data and processes the data to handle discontinuities. It focuses on analyzing the full timing of the LR04 cores.
section_blurbs.heading: LR04 Core MPT Timing (Full)

section_blurbs.blurb: Similar to the previous section, this part processes sliced data from LR04 cores, handling discontinuities and preparing the data for visualization and analysis.
section_blurbs.heading: LR04 Core MPT Timing (Sliced)
